title: $\gamma$-weakly $\theta$-up-concavity: A Unified Framework for Non-Convex Optimization Beyond DR-Submodular and OSS Functions
abstract: arXiv:2602.13506v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many objectives in machine learning and combinatorial optimization are non-concave. We introduce $\gamma$-weak $\theta$-up-concavity, a first-order condition for nonnegative monotone functions in which a scaling function $\theta$ lets the curvature change with the size of the solution. The resulting class strictly contains monotone DR-submodular functions and One-Sided Smooth (OSS) functions. It also contains functions whose marginal gains first increase and then decrease, and functions that vanish faster than any power of the norm at the origin. We construct a surrogate gradient from gradients along the segment from the origin to the current point and prove an upper-linearization inequality with a point-dependent approximation coefficient. translated_title: γ-弱θ-上凹性：超越DR-次模函数与OSS函数的非凸优化统一框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习和组合优化中的许多目标函数是非凹的。我们提出了γ-弱θ-上凹性（γ-weak θ-up-concavity），这是一种针对非负单调函数的一阶条件，其中缩放函数θ使曲率随解的规模而变化。由此得到的函数类严格包含单调DR-次模函数和单侧光滑（OSS）函数，还包含边际增益先增后减的函数，以及在原点处比范数的任意幂次更快趋于零的函数。我们利用沿从原点到当前点的线段方向上的梯度构造了一个代理梯度，并证明了一个具有依赖点的近似系数的上线性化不等式。将动作限制在逐坐标最大可行点的闭凸包上，可使该系数一致为正，其数值由曲率参数确定。
tldr: 该论文提出γ-弱θ-上凹性这一新的统一框架，严格推广了DR-次模函数和OSS函数，并通过代理梯度与上线性化不等式为更广泛的非凸优化问题提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces γ-weak θ-up-concavity, a unified first-order condition framework that strictly generalizes DR-submodular and OSS functions, providing theoretical guarantees for a broader class of non-convex optimization problems via surrogate gradients and an upper-linearization inequality.
